Our client is a fast-growing and innovative company operating in the urban mobility sector. With a strong focus on technology, design, and customer experience, they are redefining how people move around cities and are continuing to expand their presence across Europe.

Jobomschrijving

• Develop a deep understanding of the company's products and services.
• Support customers and help them get the most value from the solutions offered.
• Act as the voice of the customer and share feedback internally.
• Identify opportunities to improve customer success processes.
• Troubleshoot issues and provide effective solutions.

• Fluent in English, German,
• Analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities.

Within the Infrastructure and Security practice, together with Marie, embrace your role and be responsible for the operation, monitoring, improvement, and development of the IAM processes and tools.
Your tasks

• Guarantee the proper execution of access management services

• Provide guidance to the end-user in request management for access management and treat IAM incidents

• Monitor the performance of the systems and apply the right processes and procedures when and if issues occur

• Manage and analyze the application access rules and review the current business roles (RBAC)

• Implement and monitor the Key Performance Indicators for the Access Management Service

• Document these processes according to the client's rules and internal organization

• Participate in the IAM strategy definition and evolution

• Conduct IAM assessments and identify gaps between the AS-IS situation and the envisioned future state for the organization

• Contribute to various long-term projects to consolidate the IAM tools and the overall security environment

How do we imagine our futur Consultant

• You have at least a Bachelor degree or equivalent by experience

• You have a deep interest and will to participate in the IT security of an organization

• You are proficient using security technology and processes (Identity & Access Management aspects, Segregation of Duties, Role-Based Access Control)

• You have a good knowledge of CyberSecurity best-practices

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You have good organizational and communicational skills

• You are fluent in French and English; good knowledge of Dutch might be an asset for some projects

For our client in the Veurne area, we are looking for a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN.

Our client is a well-known garage in Veurne with a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. They are looking for a new colleague to join their team.

They are a well-established garage with a modern, clean and fully equipped workshop.

As a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN in the Veurne area, your responsibilities will include:

  • Working independently on cars and vans;
  • Carrying out technical and electrical maintenance on passenger cars and vans;
  • Performing diagnostics on vehicles;
  • Dismantling and repairing engines;
  • Replacing timing belts.
As a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN in the Veurne area, you meet the following requirements:

  • You have experience as a vehicle mechanic, preferably with experience as a diagnostic technician;
  • You are in possession of a valid category B driving licence;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality. To strengthen the production team in Drongen, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator for the carpentry department.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator in the carpentry department, you will be responsible for various woodworking and production tasks, including:
	
• Operating planing, sawing, and gluing machines	
• Processing and assembling wooden components	
• Performing quality checks on finished products	
• Ensuring production targets and quality standards are met	
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

We are looking for someone who:
	
• Has experience operating production or woodworking machines	
• Has forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate (an advantage)	
• Is not afraid of physical work	
• Can communicate in Dutch, English, or French (Polish is also welcome)	
• Is reliable, motivated, and quality-conscious

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Lokeren, we are looking for a motivated Pallet Repair Worker to join a stable and growing company. You will work in a modern pallet repair line during the day shift, where quality, safety, and teamwork are essential.

Your responsibilities
	
• Repair damaged wooden pallets according to EPAL quality standards.	
• Use a pneumatic nail gun to attach boards and blocks.	
• Replace damaged pallet components, such as boards and blocks.	
• Inspect pallets for quality, dimensions, and compliance with EPAL standards.	
• Check chamfered edges and the overall condition of the pallets.	
• Sort pallets based on their condition and repair requirements.	
• Keep your workplace safe, clean, and well organized.	
• Work closely with your colleagues to ensure an efficient production process.

Who are we looking for?
	
• Experience in a production, woodworking, or logistics environment is an advantage, but motivated candidates willing to learn are also welcome.	
• You enjoy hands-on, physical work.	
• You work accurately and pay attention to quality and detail.	
• You can safely use hand tools and machinery.	
• You can work independently as well as in a team.	
• You have a good command of English to communicate on the work floor.	
• You are reliable, motivated, and responsible.

Help build fuel stations and loading facilities across Belgium.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL 

The Tribe Artificial Intelligence aims to deliver an efficient and seamless banking experience for our customers and empower our employees through AI. Our expert team of approximately 90 experts includes Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, Product Owners and Managers. We are seeking a Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 years of experience in developing AI applications, including both generative and predictive AI. 

 

AND IN DETAIL 

• You develop AI applications to address various business challenges, including virtual assistants to enhance client experiences, advanced AI tools to support employee efficiency and creativity, and automation to optimize internal processes. 
• You use various analytical methods, including large language models (Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-tuning), speech-to-text, agentic AI applications, image generation and interpretation, and classical statistical/machine learning techniques. While expertise in all areas is not required, strong proficiency in core technologies and the ability to learn new methods as needed are essential. 
• You contribute to deploying AI applications in production using a comprehensive stack of tools. 
• You access one of the richest volumes of varied data in the market and apply your skills to it. 
• You evolve in an environment where innovation and lean processes are praised, straight-forward communication is encouraged, and peers understand the meaning of team up. 
• You work with a team of colleagues in an Agile organization who are ready to collaborate and to share their experience. 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES 

• You hold at least a Master’s degree in a quantitative field like statistics, computer science or engineering, with a focus on natural language processing. A PhD is advantageous. Candidates from other academic backgrounds with strong analytics knowledge are also welcome. 
• You have a minimum of 3 years' experience in data science, preferably in the financial sector, though less experience may be accepted if your academic achievements are substantial. 
• You are fluent in English and have a good command of French and/or Dutch. 
• You are proficient in Python for model building and understand ML engineering fundamentals (e.g., versioning systems) to produce code ready for CI/CD integration.

Responsibilities

• Design and coordinate the full implementation trajectory of the Critical Entities Resilience (CER) legislation.
• Ensure the organization meets all legal obligations regarding the resilience of critical entities.
• Implement organizational, technical, and operational measures to safeguard service continuity.
• Coordinate risk management, business continuity, and crisis management processes within the project.
• Connect and lead multidisciplinary teams to align on compliance and governance objectives.
• Follow up on legislative and organizational requirements to ensure demonstrable compliance.

Requirements

• You bring 5+ years of experience in Project Management, Compliance, Risk Management, or Business Continuity.
• You possess expert knowledge in Risk Management, Crisis Management, and Business Continuity Management (BCM).
• You have a strong understanding of Compliance and Governance processes.
• You bring affinity with infrastructure and operational security processes.
• You're analytically strong and risk-oriented with excellent coordination skills.
• You possess outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills.
• You are native or bilingual in Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with organization-wide change projects.
• Knowledge of English.

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
•  15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Responsibilities

• Own the system architecture for infrastructure platforms, including virtualization, cluster design, SAN/NAS, and DRP constructs.
• Define and maintain architectural principles, guardrails, and standards aligned with enterprise and assurance expectations.
• Develop the architectural runway to enable upcoming platform capabilities while managing technical debt and lifecycle constraints.
• Guide and challenge solution designs proposed by teams, vendors, and integrators to ensure consistency across environments.
• Lead architectural decisions regarding availability, resilience, performance, scalability, and security.
• Collaborate with stakeholders, including product management and security, to ensure architectures are operationally sound and auditable.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in system architecture focusing on IaaS compute and storage platforms.
• You bring professional expertise in storage and backup technologies such as NetApp, Cohesity, and Veritas NetBackup.
• You possess comprehensive knowledge of infrastructure components including virtualization, SAN/NAS, DRP, and High-Performance Computing (HPC).
• You have a deep understanding of Open Systems and infrastructure security.
• You're familiar with Agile methodologies and CI/CD pipelines.
• You have strong analytical mind and conceptual thinking skills.
• You are proactive and solution-oriented with strong stakeholder management abilities.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with large-scale datacenter renewal or automation initiatives.
• Knowledge of architectural governance forums and decision documentation.

We're PageGroup, one of the world's leading recruitment companies. Our success is built on collaboration, ambition, and long-term relationships.

Jobomschrijving

As a Recruiter/Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Identifying and sourcing potential candidates through various channels.
• Conducting interviews to assess candidates' skills, experience, and suitability for roles.
• Building strong relationships with clients to understand their hiring needs.
• Creating and managing job postings to attract qualified candidates.
• Providing advice and guidance to both clients and candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Maintaining accurate records of client and candidate interactions in the database.
• Ensuring compliance with all recruitment policies and industry regulations.
• Collaborating with colleagues to achieve team and individual targets.

A successful Recruiter/Consultant should have:

• A strong understanding of the business services industry.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in using recruitment tools and platforms.
• The ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines effectively.
• A proactive attitude and a keen eye for identifying talent.
• Fluency in French or Dutch, English is a plus.

Our client is a well-established international player in the fashion industry, renowned for its creativity, quality, and commitment to excellence. Based in Brussels, the company offers a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where innovation, collaboration, and passion for fashion drive success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Personal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage and organize daily schedules, appointments, and meetings of the CEO, both professional and personal.
• Prepare and handle confidential documentation.
• Be a first point of contact for the CEO, answer calls and emails.
• Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and itineraries.
• Act as a point of contact between internal teams and external stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized filing system for important documents and records.

A successful Personal Assistant should have:

• Proven experience in administrative roles (3+ years preferred, with a minimum of 2).
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
• Proficiency in using office software and tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English and preferably French or Dutch.
• A proactive and detail-oriented approach to work.

Do you have experience as a forklift driver and a valid forklift certificate?

Are you willing to work in shifts and in a fast-paced production environment?

This internationally growing production company specializes in innovative solutions for the construction and interior sector and is known for its strong focus on quality and sustainability. They are currently looking for forklift drivers to join their team in Desselgem in a stable and modern working environment.

What will you do?

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Transporting goods within the warehouse
• Supplying materials to the production lines
• SCanning and checking incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse clean and organized

• Forklift certificate
• Experience as a forklift driver
• Knowledge Dutch or English
• Willing to work in shifts

What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates
 
• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently
 
• You’ll keep your workstation tidy, because that’s how you prefer to work
 
• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome

• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English

Our client is an international industrial company operating a complex manufacturing environment with a strong focus on operational excellence and energy efficiency.

Jobomschrijving

• Analyze electrical energy consumption and identify optimization opportunities across the site.
• Conduct electrical studies and calculations (load flow, short-circuit, selectivity) and develop electrical schematics using EPLAN in compliance with applicable standards.
• Identify, develop, and implement energy-saving projects related to electrical distribution, lighting, motors, drives, and network infrastructure.
• Coordinate electrical network improvement projects, ensuring proper documentation, safety compliance, and stakeholder alignment.
• Manage electrical documentation, inspection plans, and emergency power systems while reporting progress and recommendations to management.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Energy Engineering, Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in energy management or electrical engineering within an industrial environment.
• Strong analytical mindset with a genuine interest in sustainability and energy optimization.
• Solid knowledge of high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems, energy regulations, and industrial compliance requirements.
• Autonomous, proactive, solution-oriented, and able to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch and English

Responsibilities

• Design and develop secure, performant .NET Core Web APIs and software solutions.
• Collaborate with solution designers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical implementations.
• Take full ownership of the end-to-end delivery of complete software solutions.
• Implement and maintain code quality using Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles.
• Integrate backend APIs and handle offline/online data synchronization for mobile applications.
• Set up and manage robust CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments.
• Contribute to the team's growth through knowledge sharing and a constructive professional attitude.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in .NET development, including LINQ, async/await, and security practices.
• 3+ years of experience with .NET Core Web API design and development.
• 3+ years of experience in Azure Cloud development, leveraging PaaS and event-driven patterns.
• Proven experience with Unit Testing, Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles across multiple projects.
• Professional experience with SQL and relational database design and optimization.
• Practical knowledge of Git and version control branching strategies.
• You are proactive, show initiative, and can work independently with a strong sense of ownership.
• You're calm and respectful in interactions with strong communication skills.
• You are fluent in English (C1) with C2 level proficiency in Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with CI/CD and Azure DevOps pipelines.
• Knowledge of containerized deployments using Kubernetes and Docker.
• Familiarity with Android application integration and local persistence synchronization.

jobs.occupation: Big Water Consulting - Senior Python Developer
jobs.description:
As a Senior Python Developer, you will be instrumental in architecting, developing, and maintaining resilient software solutions essential to Clients core business activities. You will work hand-in-hand with multidisciplinary teams to deliver reliable, high-performing applications while fostering the continuous enhancement of technical standards.

Your main assignment will center around the internal monitoring platform, which is dedicated to monitoring and maintaining application health. The internal monitoring facilitates the implementation and management of sophisticated synthetic and log checks for live applications, ensuring timely information about their operational status and coordinating SWIFT notification to relevant personnel whenever intervention is warranted.

At the heart the platform lie the monitoring and alerting engines, both developed in Python, alongside all associated monitoring scripts. Your skills and experience will be pivotal to the ongoing evolution and reliability of this solution.
Key responsibilities

• Collaborate actively to the development and optimization of Python-based software applications.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and define software specifications.

• Engage with customers to address service request and ensure effective resolution.

• Implement best practices for code quality, testing, and deployment (CI/CD).

• Mentor junior developers and conduct code reviews.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues.

• Work with DevOps and data engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and performance.

• Ensure security, scalability, and maintainability of solutions.

Key stakeholders:

• Other software development teams

• Product Owners & Business Analysts

• Data Engineers & Architects

• IT Operations

• Business stakeholders

• IT/tech-related academic degree (bachelor's or master's degree.

• 6+ years of experience in Development.

• 3+ years of experience using Python.

• Strong understanding of IT security requirements and their implementation ideally in the context of critical infrastructure

• Proficiency in Python for backend services, preferably with FastAPI or similar frameworks.

• Proficiency with data validation lib as Pydantic.

• Experience with Asyncio.

• Experience in SQL.

• Experience with databases like MSSQL, PostgreSQL.

• Experience with RabbitMQ.

• Strong understanding of service-based architectures and event-driven systems

• Solid conceptual knowledge of software design patterns, scalability, and continuous integration practices

• Knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g Selenium)

• Solid understanding of software design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to mentor and provide technical leadership.

• Experience working in agile environments.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

• Experience with Azure cloud is a plus.

• Experience in NoSQL solutions is a plus.

• Ability to work with legacy code and participate to refactoring initiative.

• Familiarity with containerization using Docker and deployment pipelines in a CI/CD environment is a plus.

• Good level of Dutch and/or French and English is required, German is a plus.

What do you have to do?
 

 
• As a production line operator, you set up the machine according to the correct parameters and make adjustments as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Your responsibilities will also include changing machine setups, as well as cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are willing to work in the food industry
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5am-1pm and 1pm-9pm)
 
• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player
